item.title: White House Finalizes AI Framework in Private
item.description: The White House met its deadline to create a voluntary AI evaluation framework but has not disclosed its contents.

item.title: The hidden meaning behind the yen intervention
item.description: The U.S. and Japan jointly intervened to support the yen, and their approach signals a coordinated strategy.

item.title: Potential impact of fewer Fed policy meetings
item.description: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh may consider reducing the number of annual policy meetings, which could affect market expectations.

item.title: Cyclospora outbreak leads to first two deaths
item.description: Michigan officials reported two deaths linked to the cyclosporiasis outbreak, marking the first fatalities in the multistate event.
